summary: graphify's BENCHMARKS.md reports results against named baselines with cost and judge-agreement figures (90.6% agreement, Cohen's kappa 0.81): LOCOMO recall@10 0.497 vs BM25 0.362 and mem0 0.048, LongMemEval-S 76% tied with dense RAG, and ERPNext key-fact coverage 82.0% vs 70.8% for a grep-and-read baseline (n=6); on LOCOMO QA accuracy supermemory scores higher (49.7% vs 45.3%) at about 11x the ingest cost ($15.67 vs $1.40). The harness these results point to (memory/runner.py, crosstool/run.py) is not in the repository, and no per-run outputs or spend ledgers are committed. The 71.5x token-reduction figure is backed by in-repo code (graphify benchmark) and a committed graph.json, with corpus tokens estimated from word counts rather than measured. The Graphify Cloud claim of cutting agent token spend by 80% is stated without data.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
